commands.description: Detect connections to same external IP at near-fixed intervals (jitter < 5s).

commands.description: EQL — sequence of 10 outbound connections to same IP within 10 minutes.

commands.description: Hunt for long-duration low-bandwidth sessions (slow beacons).
commands.command: event.category: network AND network.direction: outbound AND network.bytes < 1024 AND event.duration > 600000000000 AND NOT destination.ip: (10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)

commands.description: Detect abnormally long DNS query names (>50 chars in subdomain label).
commands.command: network.protocol: dns AND dns.question.name: * | where length(dns.question.name) > 50 AND dns.question.type: (A OR TXT OR CNAME)

commands.description: Hunt for NULL, ANY, or PRIVATE DNS record types used by tunneling tools.
commands.command: network.protocol: dns AND dns.question.type: (NULL OR ANY OR PRIVATE OR HINFO)

Hunt - Linux Persistence & Rootkit.description: Proactively hunt for Linux persistence mechanisms — cron jobs, systemd units, LD_PRELOAD rootkits, and SSH key backdoors.

commands.description: Cron job written by non-root process or unexpected user.
commands.command: file.path: (/etc/cron* OR /var/spool/cron/*) AND event.action: (created OR modified) AND NOT process.name: (cron OR crontab OR puppet OR ansible OR chef)

commands.description: Systemd service unit file created in user-controlled directory.
commands.command: file.path: (/etc/systemd/system/* OR /home/*/.config/systemd/*) AND event.action: created AND file.extension: service

commands.description: LD_PRELOAD or LD_LIBRARY_PATH set in shell profile — rootkit loader.
commands.command: file.path: (/etc/ld.so.preload OR /home/*/.bashrc OR /home/*/.profile OR /etc/profile) AND event.action: modified AND process.name: (* AND NOT (vi OR vim OR nano OR bash))

commands.description: SSH authorized_keys modified by non-interactive process.
commands.command: file.path: /home/*/.ssh/authorized_keys AND event.action: modified AND NOT process.name: (sshd OR ssh-agent OR puppet OR ansible)
file where event.action == "created" and file.mode : "*s*" and not file.path : ("/bin/*","/sbin/*","/usr/*")

Hunt - Linux Persistence & Rootkit.tuning: Alert on persistence outside business hours or from unusual accounts. Whitelist software deployment mechanisms. Cross-reference with Elastic change management records.

Hunt - Living-off-the-Land: Linux Binari.description: Proactively hunt for GTFOBin-style abuse of trusted Linux utilities.

commands.description: curl or wget piped to bash — download and execute pattern.
commands.command: process.name: (bash OR sh OR zsh) AND process.command_line: ((*curl* AND *| bash*) OR (*wget* AND *| bash*) OR (*curl* AND *| sh*))

commands.description: python or perl one-liner reverse shell.
commands.command: process.command_line: (*python* AND (*socket* OR *subprocess* OR *os.system*) OR *perl* AND (*socket* OR *exec*))

commands.description: find or awk used with -exec to run commands as root.
commands.command: process.name: (find OR awk) AND process.command_line: (*-exec* OR *system(* OR *BEGIN*) AND process.parent.name: (sudo OR su)

commands.description: nc (netcat) listening or connecting — reverse shell.
commands.command: process.name: (nc OR ncat OR netcat) AND process.command_line: (*-l* OR *-e /bin/bash* OR *-e /bin/sh*)

Hunt - Living-off-the-Land: Linux Binari.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Elastic data sources for context.

Hunt - Container Escape & Kubernetes Abu.description: Proactively hunt for container breakout, privileged pod abuse, and Kubernetes API server attacks.

commands.description: Process running inside container attempting to access host /proc.
commands.command: file.path: /proc/1/environ AND container.id: * AND process.name: (* AND NOT (ps OR top OR proc))

commands.description: K8s service account token read from non-pod process.
commands.command: file.path: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token AND event.action: (read OR opened) AND NOT process.name: (java OR node OR python OR ruby)

commands.description: kubectl exec into production namespace pod.
commands.command: event.dataset: kubernetes.audit AND kubernetes.audit.verb: create AND kubernetes.audit.objectRef.subresource: exec AND NOT kubernetes.audit.objectRef.namespace: (kube-system OR monitoring)
event.dataset: kubernetes.audit AND kubernetes.audit.verb: create AND kubernetes.audit.objectRef.resource: clusterrolebindings AND kubernetes.audit.requestObject.roleRef.name: cluster-admin

Hunt - macOS Specific Threats.description: Proactively hunt for macOS-specific persistence, TCC bypass, and Gatekeeper evasion.

commands.description: LaunchAgent or LaunchDaemon plist created by non-Apple process.
commands.command: file.path: (/Library/LaunchDaemons/* OR /Library/LaunchAgents/* OR /Users/*/Library/LaunchAgents/*) AND event.action: created AND NOT process.name: (installer OR softwareupdate OR jamf)
process.name: osascript AND process.command_line: (*do shell script* OR *bash* OR *curl* OR *python*)

commands.description: TCC database modified — privacy bypass attempt.
commands.command: file.path: /Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db AND event.action: modified AND NOT process.name: (tccd OR cfprefsd)
process.name: xattr AND process.command_line: (*-d com.apple.quarantine* OR *-c *)

Hunt - Memory-Only & Fileless Threats.description: Proactively hunt for in-memory payloads, process hollowing, and fileless execution.

commands.description: Process with no corresponding file on disk (hollowed process).
commands.command: process.executable: * AND NOT file.path: * AND event.type: process_started

commands.description: PE image loaded from memory without file-backed section (Sysmon 7).
commands.command: event.code: 7 AND winlog.event_data.Signed: false AND NOT winlog.event_data.ImageLoaded: (C:\\* OR /usr/* OR /bin/*)

commands.description: VirtualAlloc + WriteProcessMemory + CreateRemoteThread — classic injection triad.
commands.command: sequence by process.pid with maxspan=10s [api where winlog.event_data.api == "VirtualAllocEx"] [api where winlog.event_data.api == "WriteProcessMemory"] [api where winlog.event_data.api == "CreateRemoteThread"]

commands.description: PowerShell executing from memory with no script file on disk.
commands.command: event.code: 4104 AND powershell.file.script_block_text: * AND NOT powershell.file.path: *

Hunt - Active Directory Certificate Serv.description: Proactively hunt for ESC1-ESC8 ADCS privilege escalation and certificate theft.

commands.description: Certificate requested with SAN for another user (ESC1).

commands.command: process.command_line: (*certipy* OR *Certify* OR *Certify.exe* OR *certi*) AND process.command_line: (*find* OR *request* OR *auth* OR *shadow*)

commands.description: Certificate template with dangerous EKU (Any Purpose or No EKU) modified.
commands.command: event.code: 4899 AND winlog.event_data.OldTemplateContent: * AND winlog.event_data.NewTemplateContent: (*2.5.29.37.0* OR *"Any Purpose"*)

commands.description: NTLM relay to ADCS HTTP endpoint (ESC8) — unusual web request to CA.
commands.command: event.dataset: network_traffic.http AND url.path: (*certsrv* OR *certenroll*) AND http.request.method: POST AND NOT source.ip: ({authorized_ca_clients})

Hunt - Credential Access via Browser.description: Proactively hunt for browser credential theft, cookie export, and saved password extraction.

commands.description: Process accessing Chrome or Edge Login Data SQLite DB.
commands.command: file.path: (*\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data OR *\\Edge\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data) AND event.action: (read OR opened) AND NOT process.name: (chrome.exe OR msedge.exe OR brave.exe)
file.path: (*\\Cookies OR *\\Network\\Cookies) AND event.action: (read OR opened) AND NOT process.name: (chrome.exe OR msedge.exe OR firefox.exe OR brave.exe)

commands.description: LaZagne or browser stealer process execution.
DPAPI master key decryption by non-browser process.
commands.command: process.command_line: (*CryptUnprotectData* OR *dpapi::chrome* OR *dpapi::cred*) AND NOT process.name: (chrome.exe OR msedge.exe OR svchost.exe)

Hunt - Email-Based Threats.description: Proactively hunt for business email compromise, inbox rule abuse, and email-delivered malware.

commands.description: Inbox forwarding rule created to external address.
commands.command: event.dataset: o365.audit AND event.action: (New-InboxRule OR Set-InboxRule) AND o365.audit.Parameters: (*ForwardTo* OR *ForwardAsAttachmentTo* OR *RedirectTo*) AND NOT o365.audit.Parameters: *@yourdomain.com*
event.dataset: o365.audit AND event.action: (HardDelete OR MoveToDeletedItems OR Purge) | stats count() by o365.audit.UserId | where count > 200

commands.description: Email sent with attachment matching known malware extension from compromised account.
commands.command: event.dataset: o365.audit AND event.action: Send AND o365.audit.Parameters: (*Attachments* AND (*.exe* OR *.js* OR *.lnk* OR *.hta* OR *.iso*))

Hunt - PrintNightmare & Spooler Abuse.description: Proactively hunt for Print Spooler exploitation, PrintNightmare, and SpoolFool attacks.

commands.description: DLL dropped into Windows\System32\spool\drivers by non-spooler process.
commands.command: file.path: C:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\* AND event.action: created AND file.extension: dll AND NOT process.name: (spoolsv.exe OR msiexec.exe OR printui.exe)

commands.description: Remote print driver installation from non-admin user (CVE-2021-34527).
commands.command: event.code: 808 AND winlog.event_data.Param3: (* AND NOT (C:\\Windows\\* OR C:\\Program Files\\*))
process where process.parent.name == "spoolsv.exe" and process.name not in ("splwow64.exe","PrintIsolationHost.exe")

Hunt - Endpoint Detection Evasion.description: Proactively hunt for EDR and AV evasion techniques — unhooking, tampering, and exclusion abuse.

commands.description: Windows Defender exclusion path or process added.
commands.command: event.code: (5007 OR 5010 OR 5012) AND winlog.event_data.NewValue: (*ExclusionPath* OR *ExclusionProcess* OR *ExclusionExtension* OR *DisableRealtimeMonitoring*)

commands.description: EDR driver or service stopped or unloaded.
commands.command: event.code: 7036 AND winlog.event_data.ServiceName: (*CrowdStrike* OR *SentinelOne* OR *CarbonBlack* OR *Cylance* OR *MsMpEng*) AND winlog.event_data.ServiceState: stopped

commands.description: ntdll.dll reloaded from disk — userland hook removal.
commands.command: event.code: 7 AND winlog.event_data.ImageLoaded: *ntdll.dll AND winlog.event_data.Signed: true AND process.name: (* AND NOT (ntdll.dll OR lsass.exe OR svchost.exe))

commands.description: Process patching own memory to remove EDR hooks (Sysmon 8 self-injection).

Hunt - Endpoint Detection Evasion.tuning: Alert on defense tool modification from non-privileged sources. Whitelist scheduled maintenance windows. Correlate with subsequent suspicious activity for context.

Hunt - Sysmon: Process Create, Network,.description: Proactive threat hunting using Sysmon telemetry for process creation anomalies, network pivots, BYOVD driver loads, file drops, ADS, named pipe C2, WMI subscription persistence, DNS tunneling, and process tampering. Covers Sysmon Events 1, 3, 6, 11, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 25.

commands.description: Sysmon 1 — Office or browser spawning LOLBin/shell (spearphish initial execution, T1566).
commands.command: event.code: 1 AND process.parent.name: (WINWORD.EXE OR EXCEL.EXE OR POWERPNT.EXE OR outlook.exe OR chrome.exe OR firefox.exe OR msedge.exe) AND process.name: (cmd.exe OR powershell.exe OR wscript.exe OR mshta.exe OR cscript.exe OR regsvr32.exe OR certutil.exe OR rundll32.exe)

commands.description: Sysmon 1 — Execution from user-writable path by non-system account (dropper staging, T1204).
commands.command: event.code: 1 AND process.executable: (C:\\Users\\* OR C:\\ProgramData\\* OR C:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR C:\\Temp\\*) AND NOT process.code_signature.trusted: true AND NOT process.name: (msiexec.exe OR setup.exe)

commands.description: Sysmon 3 — Outbound connection from LOLBin or script interpreter (T1071, T1105).
commands.command: event.code: 3 AND process.name: (powershell.exe OR cmd.exe OR certutil.exe OR mshta.exe OR wscript.exe OR cscript.exe OR regsvr32.exe OR bitsadmin.exe OR curl.exe OR wget.exe) AND NOT destination.ip: (10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16 OR 127.0.0.1)

commands.description: Sysmon 6 — Driver loaded from user-writable path — BYOVD staging (T1014, T1543).
commands.command: event.code: 6 AND winlog.event_data.ImageLoaded: (C:\\Users\\* OR C:\\ProgramData\\* OR C:\\Temp\\* OR C:\\Windows\\Temp\\*) AND winlog.event_data.Signed: "true"

commands.description: Sysmon 6 — Known vulnerable driver by filename — BYOVD kill-chain enumeration.
commands.command: event.code: 6 AND winlog.event_data.ImageLoaded: (*gdrv.sys* OR *dbutil_2_3.sys* OR *rtcore64.sys* OR *AsrDrv104.sys* OR *mhyprot2.sys* OR *iqvw64e.sys* OR *KProcess.sys* OR *procexp152.sys* OR *HackSys*)

commands.description: Sysmon 11 — Executable or script dropped to suspicious writable path (stager/dropper, T1105).
commands.command: event.code: 11 AND winlog.event_data.TargetFilename: (C:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR C:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR C:\\ProgramData\\*) AND winlog.event_data.TargetFilename: (*.exe OR *.dll OR *.bat OR *.ps1 OR *.vbs OR *.hta OR *.js OR *.scr)

commands.description: Sysmon 15 — Alternate Data Stream write — payload hidden in NTFS stream (T1564.004).
commands.command: event.code: 15 AND winlog.event_data.TargetFilename: *:* AND NOT winlog.event_data.TargetFilename: (*:Zone.Identifier OR *:AFP_* OR *:com.apple* OR *:{*})

commands.description: Sysmon 17 — Named pipe created matching Cobalt Strike defaults (T1071, T1573).
commands.command: event.code: 17 AND winlog.event_data.PipeName: (*postex_* OR *msagent_* OR *MSSE-* OR *mojo.* OR *status_* OR *IEFrame* OR *wkssvc* OR *scerpc_priv* OR *spoolss_*)

commands.description: Sysmon 18 — Named pipe connected from unexpected process — C2 IPC channel.
commands.command: event.code: 18 AND NOT process.name: (svchost.exe OR lsass.exe OR chrome.exe OR firefox.exe OR msedge.exe OR explorer.exe OR spoolsv.exe) AND winlog.event_data.PipeName: (* AND NOT \\pipe\\wkssvc AND NOT \\pipe\\srvsvc AND NOT \\pipe\\netlogon AND NOT \\pipe\\lsarpc)

commands.description: Sysmon 19 — WMI Event Filter registered — persistence (T1546.003).
Sysmon 20 — WMI Event Consumer registered — CommandLine or ActiveScript consumer for persistence.
commands.command: event.code: 20 AND winlog.event_data.Destination: (* AND NOT (scrcons.exe OR mofcomp.exe OR wmiprvse.exe))

commands.description: Sysmon 21 — WMI FilterToConsumerBinding — completes WMI subscription persistence triplet (T1546.003).
Sysmon 22 — Scripting process issuing DNS query for non-standard domain — C2 or DGA (T1071.004).
commands.command: event.code: 22 AND process.name: (powershell.exe OR cmd.exe OR wscript.exe OR cscript.exe OR mshta.exe OR rundll32.exe) AND NOT winlog.event_data.QueryName: (*.microsoft.com OR *.windows.com OR *.office.com OR *.live.com OR *.windowsupdate.com)

commands.description: Sysmon 25 — Process tampering / hollowing — image replaced in memory (T1055.012).
commands.command: event.code: 25 AND NOT process.name: (MpCopyAccelerator.exe OR msiexec.exe OR MsMpEng.exe)

Hunt - Sysmon: Process Create, Network,.tuning: Tune on internal traffic anomalies. Whitelist known scanners, monitoring agents, and backup systems. Alert on internal scanning from endpoints (not servers) as high priority.

Hunt - RBCD & ADIDNS Wildcard Injection.description: Hunt for RBCD attack setup (msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity writes) and ADIDNS wildcard record injection enabling LLMNR/NBT-NS MITM without Responder.

commands.command:
event.code: "5136" and winlog.event_data.AttributeLDAPDisplayName: "msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity"
| fields @timestamp, winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName, winlog.event_data.ObjectDN, winlog.event_data.OperationType, host.name

commands.description: Hunt for machine account created by non-admin user (MAQ abuse for RBCD)
commands.command:
event.code: "4741" and not winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName: (*admin* or *svc* or *SYSTEM*)
| fields @timestamp, winlog.event_data.TargetUserName, winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName, winlog.event_data.SubjectLogonId, host.name

commands.description: Hunt for ADIDNS wildcard record creation — new DNS node in DomainDnsZones (Event 5137)
commands.command:
event.code: "5137" and winlog.event_data.ObjectDN: *DomainDnsZones* and winlog.event_data.ObjectClass: "dnsNode"
| fields @timestamp, winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName, winlog.event_data.ObjectDN, host.name

commands.description: Hunt for Responder-like activity correlated with new ADIDNS records — NTLMv2 captures from new IPs
commands.command:
event.code: "4776" and winlog.event_data.PackageName: "NTLM V2"
| stats count() by winlog.event_data.Workstation, winlog.event_data.TargetUserName
| where count > 5
| sort count desc

Hunt - PwnKit & Polkit Exploitation.description: Hunt for CVE-2021-4034 (PwnKit) pkexec privilege escalation and D-Bus service abuse on Linux endpoints.

commands.description: Hunt for pkexec executing without expected --user or action arguments (PwnKit indicator)
commands.command:
process.name: "pkexec" and not process.args: ("--user" or "--help" or "--version" or "--list")
| fields @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.args, process.parent.name

commands.description: Hunt for pkexec spawning shell or interpreter (successful privilege escalation)
commands.command:
process.parent.name: "pkexec" and process.name: ("bash" or "sh" or "python*" or "perl" or "ruby")
| fields @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.name, process.parent.name, process.args

commands.description: Hunt for pkexec executing with effective UID 0 (root) from non-root initiator
commands.command:
process.name: "pkexec" and user.id: "0" and not process.real_user.id: "0"
| fields @timestamp, host.name, user.name, user.id, process.real_user.id, process.args

commands.description: Hunt for D-Bus method calls to privileged services from unexpected processes
commands.command:
process.name: ("dbus-send" or "gdbus") and process.args: ("org.freedesktop.PolicyKit1" or "org.freedesktop.hostname1" or "org.freedesktop.systemd1")
and not process.parent.name: ("gnome-shell" or "polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1" or "systemd")
| fields @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.name, process.args, process.parent.name

Hunt - Discord & Telegram C2.description: Hunt for Discord and Telegram being abused as Command & Control channels — process connections to API endpoints, bot token patterns, and suspicious PowerShell/Python using messaging APIs.

commands.description: Hunt for processes making outbound connections to Discord/Telegram API endpoints
commands.command:
network.destination.domain: ("discord.com" or "discordapp.com" or "api.telegram.org" or "gateway.discord.gg")
and not process.name: ("chrome.exe" or "firefox.exe" or "msedge.exe" or "Discord.exe" or "Telegram.exe")
| fields @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.name, network.destination.domain, network.destination.port

commands.description: Hunt for PowerShell/Python with Discord bot token or Telegram bot token in arguments
commands.command:
process.name: ("powershell.exe" or "python.exe" or "python3") and process.command_line: ("discord" or "telegram" or "BOT_TOKEN" or "api.telegram.org" or "discord.com/api")
| fields @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.command_line

commands.description: Hunt for cmd.exe/powershell.exe spawned by Discord/Telegram process (reverse shell via C2)
commands.command:
process.parent.name: ("Discord.exe" or "Telegram.exe") and process.name: ("cmd.exe" or "powershell.exe" or "wscript.exe")
| fields @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.name, process.parent.name, process.command_line

commands.description: Hunt for high-frequency API polling to Discord/Telegram (C2 beacon — every N seconds)
commands.command:
network.destination.domain: ("discord.com" or "api.telegram.org")
| stats count() by process.name, host.name, bin(@timestamp, 5m)
| where count > 20
| sort count desc

Hunt - Discord & Telegram C2.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Elastic data sources for context.
